# NoAway

> NoAway is a desktop productivity app for macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later and Windows 10/11 (64-bit) that keeps your computer from entering an idle state so Microsoft Teams, Slack, and Zoom can stay Available. It prevents system idle at the OS level and does not interact with, inject into, or modify Teams or Slack. It does not keylog, capture your screen, access chat accounts or messages, or collect personal activity data. One-time launch price €4.99 (EUR)—no subscription, no free trial. Support: support@noaway.app

Base-URL: https://noaway.app/
